NA-tolerant summaries for heatmap tables

Source: R/notebook_utils.R
safe_summaries.Rd

Helpers used to build the iZone velocity and gene tempo heatmaps. All three drop non-finite values before computing.

Usage

cor_safe(x, y)

zscore_safe(x)

peak_bin(position, value)

Arguments

x, y

Numeric vectors of the same length.

position

Numeric vector of positions (e.g. replication progress bins).

value

Numeric vector of values at position.

Value

cor_safe() and peak_bin(): a single number. zscore_safe(): a numeric vector as long as x.

Details

  • cor_safe() returns the Pearson correlation of the finite pairs of x and y, or NA_real_ when fewer than 2 pairs are left.

  • zscore_safe() centres and scales the finite values of x. Non-finite entries stay NA. The whole result is NA when fewer than 2 values are finite or their standard deviation is 0 or not finite.

  • peak_bin() returns the position at which value is largest, using only pairs where both are finite (first one on ties), or NA_real_ when there are none.

Examples

cor_safe(c(1, 2, NA, 4), c(2, 4, 6, Inf))
#> [1] 1
zscore_safe(c(1, 2, 3, NA))
#> [1] -1  0  1 NA
peak_bin(c(0, 25, 50, 75), c(0.1, 0.8, NaN, 0.3))
#> [1] 25
